question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homonym in the context of the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

He was convicted of assaulting a police officer, but he got off with a ______ sentence.

options.text: light: any device serving as a source of illumination
light: the energy from the sun

solution:
The correct answer is **"light: not serious or profound."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is talking about someone who was convicted of assaulting a police officer but received a light sentence.
 
• "Light" can mean not serious or profound. (गंभीर या गहन नहीं)
 
 
• **Example**: *This is a **light**__ issue.*
 
 
 
• This meaning of **"light"** fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct sentence**: He was convicted of assaulting a police officer, but he got off with a __**light: not serious or profound**__ sentence.
